title: Equipartition Theorem
description: A classical equilibrium result assigning an average energy kBT/2 to each independent additive quadratic term in the energy, under the theorem's phase-space assumptions.

relations.note: Equilibrium temperature sets the energy scale kBT.
Canonical averaging of an independent quadratic energy term yields kBT/2.
Counting active quadratic terms predicts classical ideal-gas heat capacities.
